study.title: Missing declaration target and orphan document

shared_contract.navigation: Declared destinations should be linked consistently.

routes.title: Broken Borough
routes.creative_logic: This negative fixture gives its entry document only the supplied orientation and route links so missing, valid, and undeclared documents remain easy to reconcile.

observable_decisions.decision: Link the one supplied declared destination and leave the promised missing destination represented in the family contract.
observable_decisions.reason: The audit must compare declaration, document presence, and reachability instead of inferring completeness from the home page.

routes.responsive_result: The short orientation remains in ordinary document flow at both fixture widths.
routes.no_javascript_result: The supplied heading, explanation, and link remain complete.

routes.title: The valid story
routes.creative_logic: The valid child document contains the supplied article and return link; it exists to contrast a real declared destination with the missing and orphan cases.

observable_decisions.decision: Keep the article in its own directly addressable document with an ordinary return link.
observable_decisions.reason: The fixture needs one valid child route against which missing and orphan findings can be checked.

routes.responsive_result: The article remains in ordinary document flow at both fixture widths.
routes.no_javascript_result: The complete article and return link remain available.

routes.title: Missing document
routes.user_job: Reach a route that was promised.
routes.creative_logic: This planned declaration intentionally has no supplied document so the audit must report the broken promise instead of manufacturing a fallback page.

observable_decisions.decision: Declare the promised path while leaving its document absent in the source-frozen negative fixture.
observable_decisions.reason: The fixture tests whether route-count and missing-document failures remain explicit.

routes.responsive_result: No rendered result exists because the declared document is intentionally missing.
routes.reduced_motion_result: No rendered result exists because the declared document is intentionally missing.
routes.no_javascript_result: The declared destination remains unavailable and must be reported as missing.
deliberate_differences: Missing has no document to render.
Home is a complete orientation document.
